HEIC/HEIF image conversion

This application uses libheif 1.23.7 and libde265 1.1.3 under the GNU
Lesser General Public License, version 3 or later. The accompanying LICENSE,
THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md and README.md contain copyright notices, license texts,
dependencies and upstream source references for the linked components.

The application-specific decoder source, source manifest and build instructions
are provided as primary.cpp, SOURCE-MANIFEST.md and build-primary.sh in this
directory. The unmodified, pinned npm
package used for relinking is @ai-ecoverse/wasm-libheif@1.23.7-1 (SHA-256 of
the package tarball: 281a3d13d6589ee85a3e0f66928da79874dc31e5b3a912a8533925833bbff307).
The decoder files are separately served at /heic-decoder/primary.js and
/heic-decoder/primary.wasm. Replace both together with a compatible rebuild.

EXPERIMENTAL STATUS: Rebuilding against a modified library and complete legal
and patent compliance have not yet been independently established.
